rationale.conceptual: The method reduces to copying published polynomial coefficients and formatting them as JSON. No understanding of thermodynamics or CALPHAD is needed; the paper provides all numbers verbatim.
rationale.execution: A single script writes hardcoded JSON files. No pipeline, external tools, or data generation.
